description: Details required by Condition 6 (Submission of details - Trellis. Before the relevant part of the works are begun, detailed section and elevation drawings (scale 1:10) of the approved trellis shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the development shall not be completed otherwise than in accordance with the details so approved) of planning permission PP/25/02313 (Removal of one non-original front boundary pillar; replacement of pedestrian gate; installation of combined car and secondary bin gate and bin store; new lowered paving and landscaping to front garden; installation of gate and railings to lightwell; reconfiguration of stepped access to side of house; replacement of timber trellis along side boundary wall; modification to existing pavement crossover.)
